subject: Exclusive Summer Sale: 30% Off All Swimwear!
body: Dear valued customer, Dive into summer with our exclusive sale! For a limited time, enjoy 30% off on all swimwear collections. Visit our store or shop online now to make a splash with savings! Best regards, The Swimwear Co.
